sources.title: Monzo Help - Understanding fees for using your Monzo card abroad
Money Abroad: What To Know Before, During & After Your Trip
Fee-free Debit & Credit Cards Made for Travel
Your Most-Asked Travel Money Questions, Answered

brands.evidence: Spending abroad: no fee from Monzo. You can pay anywhere in any currency with your Monzo card, fee-free.

client_claims.text: You can pay anywhere in any currency with your Monzo card, fee-free.
Monzo passes on Mastercard's exchange rate without extra charges.
Cash withdrawals abroad: free up to a limit, then 3%.
Monzo is not my main bank: £400 fee-free every 30 days in UK & EEA (3% afterwards)
Monzo is not my main bank: £200 fee-free every 30 days outside EEA (3% afterwards)
If Monzo is my main bank, UK & EEA withdrawals are unlimited fee-free.
Monzo Plus: unlimited fee-free in UK & EEA and £400 fee-free every 30 days outside EEA
client_claims.note: Facts cover only the free plan and current paid plans (Extra, Perks, Max); Plus is not covered.

client_claims.text: Monzo Premium, Perks & Max: unlimited fee-free in UK & EEA and £600 fee-free every 30 days outside EEA
client_claims.note: Facts do not give allowances for paid plans.

client_claims.text: Monzo counts as your main account if your salary is paid into Monzo.
The allowance is rolling, not calendar-based.
Some ATMs charge their own fee, which Monzo doesn't receive.
Monzo's Ireland pages show a 2.5% rule with a €300 allowance.
Monzo does not charge a flat £2 withdrawal fee on UK accounts.
client_claims.note: Consistent with F7 but facts do not mention a £2 fee.
